title: European Rivers
description: The great waterways that shaped civilizations, cultures, and landscapes across Europe.

rivers.name: Danube
rivers.countries: Germany, Austria, Slovakia, Hungary, Croatia, Serbia, Romania, Bulgaria, Moldova, Ukraine
rivers.description: The second-longest river in Europe, flowing through 10 countries. It has been a vital trade route since Roman times and inspired countless works of art and music.

rivers.name: Rhine
rivers.countries: Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Austria, Germany, France, Netherlands
rivers.description: One of Europe's most important waterways, flowing through the heart of Western Europe. Its banks are dotted with medieval castles and vineyards.

rivers.name: Volga
rivers.description: The longest river in Europe, often called the 'Mother Volga' by Russians. It flows through the heart of European Russia and has been central to Russian culture and history.

rivers.name: Thames
rivers.description: The iconic river flowing through London. Though not the longest, it is one of the most historically significant rivers in the world.

rivers.name: Seine
rivers.description: The romantic river that flows through Paris, lined with beautiful bridges, museums, and historic landmarks.

rivers.name: Po
rivers.description: The longest river entirely within Italy, flowing eastward across northern Italy from the Cottian Alps to the Adriatic Sea near Venice.

footer: These rivers have witnessed the rise and fall of empires, inspired poets and painters, and continue to sustain millions of lives across Europe.
